description: This file defines the TwigCallableInterface interface in the Twig templating engine, outlining methods for callable objects used within Twig.

classes.name: TwigCallableInterface
classes.description: An interface for callable objects in Twig that extends Stringable and defines methods for obtaining callable metadata and behavior.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the callable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the callable.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns a dynamic name for the callable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the actual callable or null.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the class associated with the node.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates if environment context is needed.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified dynamic arguments.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments for the callable.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable accepts a variable number of arguments.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the callable is deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Returns the package that deprecates this callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Returns the version when the callable was deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Provides an alternative callable if available.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of arguments required.
